system.description:
• Effect: When you prepare spells, you may leave one place on your list open for each spell level you can cast; an open place counts towards your prepared total.
  • When you cast a spell of that level, you may fill the open place with any spell of that level in your spellbook as part of the casting.
  • The book must be on you, not in your hand.
  • The place then holds that spell until you next prepare.
  • A Ritual spell in your book can be cast as a ritual from an open place of its level, which fills it. Always on.
